name: FMtribe
author: Ian Guinan
tagline: a monotribe-style analogue groove box for the FM-1, written from scratch
description: A clean-room recreation of the sound and controls of a classic monophonic analogue groove box: one VCO, a two-pole MS-style filter, an LFO, three analogue-style drums and an eight-step sequencer. In development.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Not affiliated with Korg.
